Fredericia is a Danish municipality evaluated in the Annual Report from the Database for Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark (AFDK) for the period of July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. The report assesses the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities, focusing on anticoagulation therapies and safety monitoring [^src2].

In the context of Indicator 4b, which measures compliance with safety practices regarding the use of DOAC (Direct Oral Anticoagulant) medications, Fredericia performed strongly [^src1]. The municipality met the standard for Indicator 4b with a score of 95.4% (958 out of 1,004 patients), placing it among the municipalities that exceed the national standard of ≥95% [^src1]. 

Furthermore, Fredericia's performance is tracked across other key quality indicators, such as early initiation of anticoagulation (Indicator 1) and the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulation treatment (Indicator 5) [^src2]. Municipal data for Fredericia includes specific metrics such as a 0.2% (0.0-0.7) rate in one safety measure and a 0.7% rate (9 out of 1,301 patients) in another [^src2]. These detailed municipal breakdowns underscore the decentralized responsibility for quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system [^src1].
